llm.summary: This is a straightforward Gmail reply helper, but it can send messages and attachments through a configured Gmail account.

dimensions.detail: Gmail send authority and optional local file attachments are sensitive, but they are expected and disclosed for a reply-sending tool.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is a single Markdown skill with no bundled executable code, but it requires an external gws binary and references generating shared gws skills if missing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are narrow command documentation and do not contain prompt overrides, hidden behavior, unsafe automation, or unrelated agent instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact does not install persistence, background workers, hooks, services, or privilege-escalation mechanisms.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is replying to Gmail messages via the gws CLI, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: message ID, body, recipients, sender alias, attachments, HTML mode, draft, and dry-run.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you trust the gws CLI and the Gmail account it will use. Use --dry-run or --draft for sensitive replies, and review recipients, aliases, HTML content, and attachments before sending.
